findings.title: Transformed config is computed but never used
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into local `config` and translates `schedule_type` to its display value, but then returns the original `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`. The translation is dead code and consumers always get the raw schedule_type value. Return the transformed `config` variable.

findings.title: Public helpers removed/renamed without aliases
findings.body: The refactor deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and `SimpleCheckIn` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and reintroduces them under new names/locations (`try_incident_threshold` in `incidents.py`, `create_incident_occurrence` in `incident_occurrence.py`, `SimpleCheckIn` in `monitors.types`). Any existing importer of the old names breaks at import time. Keep backwards-compatible aliases in `mark_failed.py` or update all callers in the same change.
